title: UNVERIFIED — Warnervale, a Length of Blue Hose

features.name: a shed, the door open
features.desc-on-touch: A little yard beyond the fence beside the rail. Three chairs stacked against the shed.

features.name: a length of blue hose
features.desc-on-touch: It runs out from the shed. By the time you have followed it to where it disappears into grass, the yard has gone and there is the brick wall of an old Mechanics' Institute.

features.name: the PA
features.desc-on-touch: It is asking his questions for him, but they are stations: Wyong, Wyee. Names, he thinks, for places of running water, of bush fire, of words and worlds on the other side of every iteration of time he will be associated with.

features.name: the front seat of a van, empty
features.desc-on-touch: Seen over a sidelong hedge. Then the road leans away and the hedge continues in parallax.

inscription: there is a rattle beneath the window and I put my elbow on the ledge, which stops it

file.name: PA_Wyong_Wyee_Warnervale.wav
file.note: The voice breaks up at Warnervale, though it continues for several seconds.
